title: 第二十三章 不肯交
content_zh:
那场布摊上的事过后，江砚病了两天。

    不是寻常的病。呕了那口血，又是高烧，又是浑身脱力，跟一场大病似的。秦伯没多问，只熬了药给他灌下去，又守着他退烧。第三天江砚才缓过劲来，脸还是蜡黄的，嘴唇没什么血色。

    “那根棍子,”秦伯端着药碗坐在床头,慢悠悠地开口,“凭空就到了你手里。”

    江砚心里一紧,没接话。

    秦伯也不追问,只把药碗递过来：“喝了。”他顿了顿，看着江砚，那双老眼里说不清是了然还是担忧，“小子,有些本事,留着护命是好的。可这世道，怪本事就是怪罪过。藏好了，比什么都强。”

    江砚低着头喝药，苦得他直皱眉，心里却比这药还沉。

    他知道自己露了怯。集上那么多双眼睛，就算大伙儿只当是变戏法、看花了眼，可这世上,总有看得真切的人。

    他怕的，就是那个看得真切的人。

    ——

    第四天上午，那人就来了。

    来的不是嗅迹者本人。

    是三个人。打头的是个穿酱色直裰的中年管事，圆脸,笑眯眯的，一看就是常年在人前打交道的。身后跟着两个挎刀的汉子，眼神冷,站姿稳，一看就不是寻常市井里混的。

    那管事进了铺子，先客客气气地拱了拱手：“敢问，可是替人写信的江小先生?”

    江砚搁下笔，心里那根弦一下绷紧了。

    这三人来路不对。寻常求写信的，不带挎刀的。

    “是我。”他不动声色，“客官要写信，还是记账?”

    “都不是。”那管事笑容更深，自顾自在对面坐下，挥手让两个挎刀的守在门口，把光都遮了大半，“小先生,咱们打开天窗说亮话。我家主子,姓什么不要紧,要紧的是——我家主子，最爱结交有本事的人。”

    他往前凑了凑,压低了声：“前几日集上那一手,我家主子,都瞧见了。”

    江砚的手,在案下慢慢攥成了拳。

    果然。

    “客官说什么,我不懂。”他面上仍是平静，“集上我不过仗着年轻气盛，多管了桩闲事。”

    “哎，小先生何必跟我装糊涂。”管事摆摆手，从袖中摸出一锭银子,“当”地搁在案上,足有十两,在这小铺子里晃得人眼花，“凭空变出根棍子来,这可不是‘年轻气盛’四个字能糊弄过去的。我家主子说了,小先生这身本事,埋没在这破病坊里替贩夫走卒写信记账,可惜了。”

    他指尖点着那锭银子，一字一句:“跟了我家主子，吃香的喝辣的,要什么有什么。这点银子,不过是个见面礼。日后小先生想要的,远不止这些。”

    江砚盯着那锭银子。
content_en:
After the incident at the cloth stall, Jiang Yan was ill for two days.

    It's not an ordinary disease. I vomited a mouthful of blood, had a high fever, and felt exhausted all over, as if I was seriously ill. Uncle Qin didn't ask any more questions. He just boiled the medicine and drank it for him, then watched him reduce the fever. Jiang Yan finally regained his composure on the third day, but his face was still sallow and his lips had no color.

    "That stick," Uncle Qin said slowly, sitting on the bedside with a medicine bowl in his hand, "it came into your hands out of thin air."

    Jiang Yan felt nervous and did not answer.

    Uncle Qin didn't ask any further questions. He just handed over the medicine bowl and said, "Drink." He paused and looked at Jiang Yan. He could not tell whether he was understanding or worried in his old eyes. "Boy, it's good to keep some skills to protect your life. But in this world, blaming the fault is the fault of the skill. Hiding it is better than anything else."

    Jiang Yan lowered his head and drank the medicine. He frowned in pain, but his heart was heavier than the medicine.

    He knew he was showing cowardice. With so many pairs of eyes, even if everyone just thinks it's a trick and is dazzled, there are always people in this world who can see clearly.

    What he is afraid of is the person who sees it clearly.

    ——

    On the morning of the fourth day, the man came.

    It was not the sniffer himself.

    It's three people. The person at the head was a middle-aged steward wearing a brown t-shirt. He had a round face and a smiling face. From the first glance, he looked like he had been in front of people all year round. Behind them were two men carrying knives. They had cold eyes and a steady posture. At first glance, they were not ordinary people in the market.

    The steward entered the shop and bowed his hands politely: "I dare to ask, but is it Mr. Jiang who writes letters for others?"

    Jiang Yan put down his pen, and the string in his heart suddenly tightened.

    These three people came from the wrong place. I usually ask for people who write letters and don’t carry a knife.

    "It's me." He said calmly, "Sir, do you want to write a letter or keep accounts?"

    "None of them." The steward's smile deepened, and he sat down across from him. He waved to the two men carrying knives to guard the door, blocking most of the light. "Little sir, let's open the skylight and speak frankly. My master's last name doesn't matter. The important thing is that my master loves to make friends with capable people."

    He leaned forward and lowered his voice: "My master saw what he did a few days ago."

    Jiang Yan's hands slowly clenched into fists under the case.

    really.

    "I don't understand what the guest said." His face was still calm, "I just took advantage of my youth and energy to meddle in other people's affairs."

    "Hey, young gentleman, why do you have to pretend to be confused with me?" The steward waved his hand, took out a piece of silver from his sleeve, and placed it on the case, a total of ten taels, which dazzled everyone in the small shop. "Conjuring a stick out of thin air cannot be fooled by the words 'young and energetic'. My master said, it is a pity that the young gentleman's ability is buried in this shabby hospital writing letters and keeping accounts for traffickers and lackeys."

    He pointed at the ingot of silver with his fingertips and said word by word: "Follow my master, enjoy the good food and drink, and get whatever you want. This small amount of money is just a meeting gift. In the future, the young gentleman will want much more than this."

    Jiang Yan stared at the ingot of silver.
